title: Sony WH-1000XM6 headphones
text: Over-ear wireless headphones with active noise cancellation and up to 30 hours of battery life. Useful for studying in noisy spaces.

title: Pocket power bank
text: Portable 20,000 mAh battery with two USB-C ports. Recharges mobile devices several times when wall power is unavailable.

title: Waterproof laptop backpack
text: Rain-resistant backpack with sealed zippers and a padded compartment for a 16-inch laptop. Keeps electronics and notes dry during wet commutes.

title: Sunrise alarm clock
text: Gradually brightens the room before the alarm sounds. Designed to make waking up on dark winter mornings easier.

title: Ergonomic keyboard
text: Split keyboard with a padded wrist rest. Designed to reduce wrist strain during long typing and programming sessions.

title: Laptop stand
text: Raises a laptop screen to eye level and folds flat for carrying. An external keyboard is recommended for prolonged use.

title: USB-C hub
text: The HUB-7X adds HDMI, Ethernet, an SD-card reader, and three USB ports to laptops with limited connections.

title: Insulated travel mug
text: Leak-resistant 500 mL mug that keeps coffee hot for eight hours. Fits standard campus cup holders.

title: Pomodoro timer
text: Distraction-free timer with 25- and 50-minute study modes. It does not connect to a phone.

title: Bike-light set
text: Rechargeable front and rear bicycle lights with weather-resistant housings. Improves visibility when commuting after dark.

title: Mini rice cooker
text: Compact rice cooker suitable for a dormitory kitchen. Makes two servings and switches automatically to warming mode.

title: White-noise machine
text: Produces fan, rain, and ambient sounds without playing music. Intended for sleep or concentration.

title: Study-skills article
text: An article describing ways to concentrate in a busy library.

title: Vancouver weather guide
text: An article about preparing for wet and dark winter commutes in Vancouver.
